comments.body:
I use the Xodo + Polybox combination on Android, but it should also work on iOS.

If you open a file on your polybox from the Xodo application, it will automatically synchronise it at certain intervals while you write.
Xodo directly annotates the pdf, so you can still change your annotations when viewing your pdf from a computer - unlike other apps like Flexcil which locally also stores it as an annotated pdf but you have to manually upload it (or or other apps that transform it from their fileformat to a flattened pdf)
comments.author: KRuss7
